title: The Quiet Autopsy
author: Elodie Nystrom
blurb: Sebastian Eriksen, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
